messages:
Harper (Design): quick QA catch: the split-action button (primary + chevron) on the deploy row has a tiny hover/tap target on the chevron when compact tokens are enabled. users on touch devices struggle to open the dropdown.
Vik - Eng: can you repro steps and viewport?
Harper (Design): Models -> Deployments list, compact density, hover over the split button. chevron area feels ~28px. GIF attached.
Marta (Design Systems): that sounds like compact alias shaved inner padding. our split button is composed of two inline buttons; the chevron uses `padding-inline: var(--space-xxs)` which gets small in compact mode. we intentionally reduced visual padding but forgot to preserve touch-area.
Jon (QA): blocking for small-device flow — testers accidentally trigger primary action when trying to open dropdown. hurts discoverability.
Vik - Eng: short-term fix: increase chevron min-width to 44px via `.split-button__chevron { min-inline-size: 44px; }` and add `touch-action: manipulation;` to reduce accidental double-tap delays.
Marta (Design Systems): long-term: add `--touch-target` token and update split-button component to expand hit area using negative margin + padding while keeping visual size. also add a design token test that computes effective hit area for any button variant.
Harper (Design): copy/accessibility nit: chevron-only button needs aria-label "Open actions"; currently it's only `aria-haspopup` which is insufficient for screen reader clarity. also keyboard focus outline disappears when adjacent primary has focus; focus should be visible for both parts independently.
Vik - Eng: will add `aria-label="Open split actions"` and ensure `:focus-visible` rule applies to `.split-button__chevron` with higher z-index than adjacent element.
Marta (Design Systems): also propose a visual affordance change: add a subtle vertical divider and extend the hit area by 6px without changing visual padding. that preserves compact look while fixing tapability.
Jon (QA): will verify on iPhone SE and Android 7" emulators once PR lands. also adding a Percy snapshot for compact split-button states: default, hover, focus, with toast visible.
release-bot: opened PR `split-button-touch-target-1766` preview https://staging.redwood.ai/pr/2899 :white_check_mark:
Vik - Eng: implemented min-inline-size + aria-label + focus fix. left screenshots in PR. performance note: no layout thrash observed.
Harper (Design): looks good on staging. small motion nit: dropdown caret transition is a bit slow (200ms) compared to token motion (120ms). will align in a follow-up but not blocking.
Marta (Design Systems): adding token `--touch-target` to the tokens README and a linter that flags effective hit areas under 44px. will also update the compact alias to respect it.
Jon (QA): passing on mobile checks. merging when CI green.
Harper (Design): thanks team — small fix but important for mobile UX :sparkles:
